channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: Why China's Performance EVs Keep Pulling Ahead
item.dc:creator: Cars with Miles
item.description: Cars with Miles spends a week in China and finds the charging network, showrooms, and pace of new brands harder to dismiss than the horsepower figures.

item.title: A Full Engineering Breakdown of the Rivian R2 Before You Buy
item.dc:creator: Engineering Explained
item.description: Engineering Explained walks through the Rivian R2's range, 29-minute charging, battery cells, and door handles, and where Rivian cut to reach about 60,000 dollars.

item.title: Wehrlein Grabs Shanghai Pole as the Title Fight Tightens
item.dc:creator: Formula E
item.description: Pascal Wehrlein beats championship leader Mitch Evans to pole for Round 12 in Shanghai, cutting his title deficit to 24 points.

item.title: Four Used EVs Worth Buying for Under $25,000 in 2026
item.dc:creator: Ever
item.description: Ever names four used EVs worth buying under $25,000: the Mustang Mach-E, Ioniq 5, Tesla Model 3, and Polestar 2, with the reliability catch for each.

item.title: EV or Plug-In Hybrid: Which One Actually Fits Your Driveway
item.dc:creator: Edmunds Cars
item.description: Edmunds compares a RAV4 plug-in and a Toyota bZ EV of similar size and price, and finds the right answer depends on your driveway, not the cars.

item.title: ABB E-mobility Bets on Modular Charging Up to the Megawatt Level
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec Reviews tours ABB's A, M, and X charging families at ACT, where the plan is to size sites to real use and scale past the megawatt level.

item.title: The McLaren W1 Is 1,200 HP of Show, With a Tiny EV Asterisk
item.dc:creator: Auto Focus
item.description: Yes, it is a plug-in hybrid with a 1.4 kWh battery. There is an electric motor though, so we are counting it. Auto Focus drives McLaren's 1,200 horsepower W1.

item.title: The First Rivian R2 Highway Range Test Comes In at 259 Miles
item.dc:creator: State Of Charge
item.description: State of Charge runs what Tom Moloughney calls the first independent R2 highway range test: 259 miles on all-terrain tires over a rough Colorado loop.

item.title: Utah Legalized Plug-In Solar. A Missing Standard Is Holding It Back
item.dc:creator: KUTV 2 News
item.description: KUTV 2 News reports Utah was first to legalize plug-in solar as a plug-and-play appliance, but a missing UL safety standard is keeping products off shelves.

item.title: Tesla's Model Y L Reaches America as a Six-Seat, Three-Row Stretch
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec
item.description: Out of Spec digs through Tesla's spec sheet for the stretched three-row Model Y L: six seats, 325 miles, and a launch price near 63,000 dollars.

item.title: BYD's Blade Battery 2.0 Aims to Make Cheap LFP Charge in Minutes
item.dc:creator: Ziroth
item.description: Ziroth digs into BYD's new LFP pack, which the company says can add a 10 to 70 percent charge in about five minutes at its flash chargers.

item.title: XPENG's L03 Takes China's EV Price War to 63 Markets
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric APAC
item.description: Everything Electric APAC walks around XPENG's coupe styled electric SUV, expected under 25,000 dollars and aimed at buyers well beyond China.

item.title: Intersolar 2026: The Race to a 500 Watt Home Solar Panel
item.dc:creator: Artisan Electrics
item.description: Artisan Electrics tours Munich's big solar show, where Aiko showed a 500 watt standard size panel and rivals are chasing the same mark.

item.title: XPENG's X9 REV Adds a Petrol Backup to a 1,600 km MPV
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric CARS
item.description: Everything Electric CARS drives XPENG's range extender MPV, which pairs a 63 kWh battery with a small petrol generator for long trips.

item.title: Why the R2 Is the Car Rivian Cannot Afford to Get Wrong
item.dc:creator: The Verge
item.description: On The Vergecast, editor Andy Hawkins and host David Pierce weigh whether Rivian's cheaper R2 can carry the company into the mainstream.

item.title: Porsche's Macan GTS EV Nails the Driving, Fights the Market
item.dc:creator: Doug DeMuro
item.description: Doug DeMuro reviews the 2026 Macan GTS electric, a roughly $125,000 SUV he rates among the sharpest-driving EVs he has tried, landing just as US electric demand cools.

item.title: The Self-Driving Story Nobody Is Telling
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The autonomy debate is all horse race. But for millions of people who cannot drive, a car that drives itself is the keys, handed back. Why Rivian's road to Level 4 matters more than the spec sheet, and the one thing it still has to get right.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
